# x402 Digital Vending Machine

Production Schema Gate for automated JSON acceptance decisions, with legacy
text normalization retained for compatibility.

Primary endpoint: POST https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/v1/schema-gate
Required keys: order_id, idempotency_key, input, target_schema,
acceptance_criteria, acceptance_commitment
Optional key: expires_at
Commitment: sha256 of sorted, compact JSON acceptance_criteria
Verdict: ACCEPT or REJECT; output exists only for ACCEPT
Price: 0.010 USDC (10000 atomic units) per completed signed evaluation
Billing: both ACCEPT and REJECT are paid; malformed preflight, payment, and
provider failures are unsettled; exact idempotent recovery has no second charge
Usage: every new task is a new paid execution; SDK integration itself is free

Storefront: https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/
Endpoint: POST https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/v1/clean
Input: {"text":"Raw   text"}
Output: structured JSON containing normalized text
Price: 0.002 USDC (2000 atomic units) per call
Protocol: x402 v2, exact scheme
Network: solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp
Asset: EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v
Recipient: E2PxHWFSwzt6a3osZRQeT16tsb7BPLfXEMuDfjnZuhFD

Send an unpaid request to receive PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Submit the canonical
base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. A wallet address or raw
transaction hash is not valid proof. Settled calls return PAYMENT-RESPONSE and
the normalized JSON result.

Discovery: https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/.well-known/x402.json
OpenAPI: https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/openapi.json
SDK: https://github.com/woodhouseog/x402-digital-vending-machine

The repository contains a portable MCP descriptor, but no MCP registry listing
or PyPI publication is claimed.
